definitions.ci: 10000 percentile paired net bootstraps, stratified by degree/distribution, identical net draws across seeds and methods
definitions.limitation: conditional on the three trained seeds; does not estimate a population of training seeds; no multiple-comparison adjustment
definitions.mean: equal degree and training-seed macro mean
definitions.p95: mean of per-degree/per-seed P95; not pooled or P95 of seed-averaged nets
definitions.worst_group: max of three OOD group mean regrets
